objectives.description: Redeploy (deploy-headless.sh) and run the complete gate set with explicit source-store TARGET; gate 27 passes clean; two fast-gate failures (shellcheck in lean extension, dead-command-recommendation in memory extension) confirmed pre-existing/unrelated and recorded

Scoped run-all.sh --only over the 71-file migrated family (70 migrated + the new lint's own suite) against the freshly-deployed tree found and fixed a genuine Phase-8-discovered regression: test-lint-subject-resolution-declaration.sh's own Case 6 fixture hardcoded a now-drained migration-pending allowlist path (test-force-phases.sh); retargeted at the permanent exemption test-common-lib.sh. Also found and recorded as pre-existing/unrelated: test-task-type-detect.sh's structural [-f]-on-a-directory bug in its REAL_EXT_ROOT fallback branch, and test-lint-unit-integration-boundary.sh's 3 classification-data mismatches (none in this task's scope)
Final redeploy and full source-store-target gate set confirming no new failures beyond the enumerated known-unrelated set plus the issues recorded this phase
